description: This file contains utility functions for handling expanded weights in PyTorch, including functions for batching, argument separation, forward pass helpers, validation, and tensor reduction, specific to the 'expanded_weights' implementation within the torch.nn.utils module.

classes.name: ExpandedWeight
classes.description: A class representing expanded weights used in advanced PyTorch operations for improved gradient computation and weight handling with support for batching and other features.

methods.name: is_batch_first(expanded_args_and_kwargs)
methods.description: Determines if the batch dimension is first across multiple ExpandedWeight arguments; raises RuntimeError if conflicting values are found.

methods.name: standard_kwargs(kwarg_names, expanded_args)
methods.description: Separates positional args and keyword args from expanded argument lists, standardizing kwargs for torch functions.

methods.name: forward_helper(func, expanded_args, expanded_kwargs)
methods.description: Executes a forward pass of a function with expanded weights, handling argument unwrapping and detachment.

methods.name: _check_and_unexpand_args(func, expanded_args, expanded_kwargs)
methods.description: Validates expanded arguments and converts them to their original weights for computation, raising errors if conditions are not met.

methods.name: maybe_scale_by_batch_size(grad_sample, expanded_weight)
methods.description: Scales gradient samples by batch size if the loss reduction is set to 'mean'.

methods.name: None set_grad_sample_if_exists(maybe_expanded_weight, per_sample_grad_fn)
methods.description: Sets the gradient sample in an unpacked tensor or ExpandedWeight, considering batch size and reduction settings.

methods.name: unpack_expanded_weight_or_tensor(maybe_expanded_weight, func=lambda x: x)
methods.description: Unpacks an ExpandedWeight to its original weight or returns the tensor directly, with error checking for incompatible types.

methods.name: torch.Tensor sum_over_all_but_batch_and_last_n( tensor: torch.Tensor, n_dims: int, )
methods.description: Computes a sum over all dimensions except the batch and the last 'n_dims' dimensions, useful for gradients and loss computations.
